description: This file defines the DoctrineCacheAdapter class which implements cache interface wrappers around Doctrine's caching component. It provides methods to interact with cache such as get, set, delete, and check existence.

classes.name: DoctrineCacheAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class implementing cache interface by wrapping Doctrine's Cache object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a Doctrine Cache instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from cache associated with the given key.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Alias for get() method, retrieves a value from cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache under the specified key with optional TTL.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Alias for set() method, saves a value into cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry for the given key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Alias for remove() method, deletes cache entry.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for the given key.
